Parts.Description: Fresh snow, a big frozen lake in the front right and a pale ice forecourt before the palace.
Parts.Name: Frozen Plain

Parts.Description: The ice palace itself: a great glacier hall with a crowned central keep and four slender corner towers.
Parts.Name: Frost Palace

Parts.Description: A great ring of aurora crystals rising behind the Frost Shiba, leaning out like the petals of a flower.
Parts.Name: Aurora Crystal Halo

Parts.Description: A tall ice gateway before the palace, crowned with a crystal spire and flanked by snow banks.
Parts.Name: Glacier Gate

Parts.Description: Two round snow igloos with tunnel doors, a stack of ice blocks and a little red flag.
Parts.Name: Igloo Village

Parts.Description: A little skating rink with a wooden rim, a bench and two lamps, right on the frozen lake.
Parts.Name: Skating Rink

Parts.Description: A big, a middle and a small snowman with top hats, scarves, carrot noses and stick arms.
Parts.Name: Snowman Family

Parts.Description: A red sled stacked high with wrapped presents, a sack of toys and a little striped tree.
Parts.Name: Sled and Presents

Parts.Description: A fountain frozen solid mid-splash, with a crown of ice spikes around its icy bowl.
Parts.Name: Frozen Fountain

Parts.Description: A cosy log cabin under a deep snow roof, with a smoking chimney, a porch and a pile of firewood.
Parts.Name: Snowy Cabin

Parts.Description: Three tall slender ice spires rising out of a snow mound, each leaning its own way.
Parts.Name: Frost Spires

Parts.Description: Carved ice on snowy pedestals: a tiny Shiba, a swan and a giant snowflake.
Parts.Name: Ice Sculpture Garden

Parts.Description: A tall ice tower with steps up the front and a long smooth slide down the side.
Parts.Name: Great Ice Slide

Parts.Description: A little iceberg crowded with waddling penguins, all pretending not to watch the Shiba.
Parts.Name: Penguin Colony

Parts.Description: A tiny blue fishing hut on the lake with a hole in the ice, a bucket of fish and a crate.
Parts.Name: Ice Fishing Hut

Parts.Description: A snow-making machine on a steel frame, puffing out a fluffy white cloud.
Parts.Name: Snow Cannon

Parts.Description: A burst of seven big crystals growing out of a blue rock, leaning in all directions.
Parts.Name: Crystal Cluster

Parts.Description: A snowball-fight fort with crenellated walls and neat piles of ready-made snowballs.
Parts.Name: Snow Fort

Parts.Description: A warm rocky spring pool wrapped in steam, with a bench and a rack for the towels.
Parts.Name: Steaming Hot Spring

Parts.Description: A towering blue glacier cliff with sharp spurs and a snow cap, guarding the end of the lake.
Parts.Name: Glacier Cliff

Parts.Description: A round stone tower with a blue dome and a long brass-and-ice telescope aimed at the aurora.
Parts.Name: Frost Observatory

Parts.Description: A spiky ice throne on a frosty dais between two crystal pillars: the seat of the Frost Queen.
Parts.Name: Ice Throne

Parts.Description: A tall crystal obelisk wrapped in floating rings of green and purple aurora light.
Parts.Name: Aurora Obelisk

Parts.Description: A huge ice dragon carved from the glacier, wings half open and a long neck stretched toward the walkway.
Parts.Name: Frost Drake

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a giant crown of clear ice and gold on a stone plinth, set with a huge red jewel.
Parts.Name: Giant Ice Crown
